title: performance_history
description: Memory block written by Agent 6.1 (Performance Analytics, Layer 6). A time-indexed, closed-loop reconciliation of live distribution actuals against the binding KPI contracts. For one reporting window it joins paid spend/results (ad_campaign_log, 5.1), organic publish results (publish_log, 5.2), and lead outcomes (lead_register, 5.3), computes the canonical funnel metrics (ROAS, CPL, CAC, CTR, plus reach/leads/conversion), and reconciles each against active_strategy.kpi_contracts (2.1). Reads: ad_campaign_log (5.1), publish_log (5.2), lead_register (5.3), active_strategy (2.1, carries kpi_contracts). Read by Layer 1 (re-baselining diagnostics) and Layer 2 (next-cycle strategy). Human gate: auto + alert — gate_status is 'auto_approved' on a normal reconciliation; the agent escalates (raises alerts, sets escalated=true) on a KPI breach but does NOT itself block the pipeline. Confidence-metadata pattern: DEL-09.

confidence_metadata.description: DEL-09 Data Confidence Tagger pattern. 'measured' = computed from real distribution actuals; 'partial' = window incomplete (some upstream block missing/thin); 'estimated' = inferred where actuals were absent.

kpi_reconciliation.description: One KPI reconciled: contracted target (from active_strategy.kpi_contracts) vs the measured actual for this window, with a status and variance.

metric.description: Canonical metric key. One of: roas, cpl_usd, cac_usd, ctr_pct, leads, conversion_rate_pct, reach, spend_usd, revenue_usd, impressions, clicks.

target_value.description: Contracted target from active_strategy.kpi_contracts. Null when the contract left it unset (flagged, not breached).

threshold_floor.description: Minimum acceptable value from the contract before a breach is raised. Null when none was contracted.

actual_value.description: Measured actual for this window. Null only when no upstream data supports the metric (then status='no_data').

variance_pct.description: Signed percentage variance of actual vs target ((actual-target)/target*100). Sign convention is interpreted per metric direction in the prompt. Null when target is null.

direction.description: Whether a higher actual (roas, leads, reach, ctr, conversion) or a lower actual (cpl, cac) is good. Determines breach logic.

status.description: on_track within tolerance; ahead beats target; at_risk inside the warning band; breach crosses the threshold_floor (or target when no floor) in the bad direction; no_data when actual is null; no_contract when this metric had no contracted target.

message.description: EN operator-facing alert text. No COGS/margins.

client_id.description: Client identifier. Lowercase-hyphenated. Must match the upstream blocks.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime this reconciliation was generated; the reference 'now' for the window.

gate_status.description: Gate posture of this agent's OWN output. Always 'auto_approved' — Agent 6.1 is auto + alert: it reconciles autonomously and raises alerts on breach, but it does not block the pipeline. The escalation signal lives in `escalated` / `alerts`, not in a blocking gate_status.

escalated.description: True when at least one KPI is in 'breach' (or a critical alert was raised). Drives the operator-alert fan-out; gate_status stays 'auto_approved'.

cycle_label.description: Marketing cycle this window belongs to, e.g. '2026-Q3 launch cycle'. Mirrors active_strategy.cycle.label when available.

window.description: The reporting window these actuals cover.

metrics.description: Computed funnel actuals for the window, in USD where monetary (USD invoicing across all four markets). All optional individually but the object is required.

spend_usd.description: Total paid-media spend for the window (from ad_campaign_log).

revenue_usd.description: Attributed revenue for the window (from lead_register conversions).

leads.description: Leads captured in the window (from lead_register).

customers.description: Closed/converted customers in the window (from lead_register).

roas.description: Return on ad spend ratio (revenue / spend).

by_channel.description: Optional per-channel breakdown of the same metrics. Used by Layer 2 to inform next-cycle channel reallocation.

kpi_reconciliation.description: One entry per contracted KPI from active_strategy.kpi_contracts, reconciled against the measured actual. When no contract is available a single 'no_contract' learning-mode entry is emitted instead.

alerts.description: Breach / at-risk / data-gap alerts surfaced to the operator. Empty on a clean window.

upstream_provenance.description: Which upstream blocks were available when this window was reconciled — drives the data-confidence narrative and partial-window flagging.

headline.description: One-line EN headline of the window result.

recommended_action.description: PROCEED clean; MONITOR at-risk/data-gap only; ALERT on at least one breach (mirrors escalated=true).

notes.description: EN — assumptions, partial-window reasons, learning-mode (no contract) note, data gaps. No COGS/margins.
